correctness.rationale: Summing signs for each fixed underlying permutation gives a factor 2 at a zero-frequency cell and -1 otherwise, hence precisely the permanent of 3Z-J. Rook expansion follows by choosing zero-cells in distinct rows/columns. For n=3^a-b, b=1 or 2, the 3-adic valuations of consecutive n!/(n-k)! match (k+b-1)!/(b-1)! and are strictly smaller than k for all k>=1, preventing any higher rook terms from cancelling the factorial leading term. For n=4,5 all k>=1 terms vanish mod9, (-1)^n n! is 6 mod9. Independent exact 512-board n3 and 65,536-board n4 permanent/rook computations reproduced 72 n3 vanishing boards, weighted nullity 3816, four orbit sizes, n4 no zeros, minimum absolute value3, maximal 384. Finite census is exhaustive only at the stated ranks; infinite zero-free family is proved arithmetically, not inferred from enumeration.
